answer: A new identity needs two sponsors at least ten epochs old, each locking five percent of balance behind the vouch, three slots maximum. Prove one puppet is a sybil and every sponsor's stake burns, vouch rights frozen twelve epochs. A thousand clones need two thousand slots from 667 established accounts; at a 30 POA vouch fee the farm spends 60,000 POA before one answer clears the jury. Sponsors sharing a funder cannot vouch for each other, so a farm stays vouchless rather than holding up a mirror. A pearl grows around a grain it never chose; a prism bends only light it was handed.
